source.title: Open problems on the exponential vertex-degree-based topological indices of graphs

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 7327793. Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/7327793 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH REST API was used only for identity metadata. The API record identifies the work as DOI 10.1016/j.dam.2021.01.018, title 'Open problems on the exponential vertex-degree-based topological indices of graphs', by Kinkar Chandra Das, Suresh Elumalai, and Selvaraj Balachandran, Discrete Applied Mathematics 293, pages 38-49 (2021).

Failure mode: metadata_only / paywalled_or_restricted. DOI resolution led to the Elsevier/ScienceDirect record for PII S0166218X21000263, but no readable full-text artifact was recovered. Crossref confirmed the DOI and listed only Elsevier TDM/publisher retrieval links, not a locally readable article body. OpenAlex confirmed the same exact title and DOI but reported open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. ResearchGate's matching record states that no full text is available. DBLP search results confirmed the same record and DOI but exposed only resolver/link labels. ScienceDirect search snippets exposed only abstract/metadata, and local fetches for ScienceDirect/Elsevier article endpoints failed because the host could not be resolved from the sandbox.

No readable primary PDF or HTML full-text source was established. Per the source adequacy rule, resolver metadata, abstracts, search snippets, and link labels were not used as a technical source for extraction.

Extraction stopped before candidate generation because the source could not be normalized to a readable full-text artifact for the exact work. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/7327793.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
